actions.name: exploited Fortinet FortiOS and Microsoft Exchange server vulnerabilities for initial access
actions.description: The IRGC-affiliated actors exploited known Fortinet FortiOS and Microsoft Exchange server vulnerabilities including CVE-2018-13379, CVE-2020-12812, CVE-2019-5591, CVE-2021-34473, CVE-2021-34523, and CVE-2021-31207 to gain initial access to targeted entities.

actions.name: exploited VMware Horizon Log4j vulnerabilities for initial access
actions.description: The IRGC-affiliated actors exploited VMware Horizon Log4j vulnerabilities CVE-2021-44228, CVE-2021-45046, and CVE-2021-45105 for initial access.

actions.name: moved laterally within networks after initial access
actions.description: After gaining access, the IRGC-affiliated actors moved laterally within the targeted networks.

actions.name: encrypted network devices with BitLocker
actions.description: The IRGC-affiliated actors forced BitLocker activation on host networks to encrypt data and held the decryption keys for ransom.

actions.name: held decryption keys for ransom and sent ransom notes
actions.description: The actors held the BitLocker decryption keys for ransom and sent ransom notes to targeted entities via files or networked printers.

actions.name: established persistent access
actions.description: The IRGC-affiliated actors established persistent access on targeted networks after initial access.

actions.name: initiated crypto-mining operations
actions.description: The actors initiated crypto-mining operations on a U.S. municipal government network after exploiting Log4j vulnerabilities.

actions.name: exfiltrated data using a server associated with IRGC-affiliated actors
actions.description: The actors leveraged a server associated with IRGC-affiliated actors to exfiltrate data from a U.S. aerospace company network.

actions.name: created new user accounts on domain controllers, servers, workstations, and active directories
actions.description: The IRGC-affiliated actors established new user accounts on domain controllers, servers, workstations, and active directories to maintain access and escalate privileges.

actions.name: enabled built-in Windows account (DefaultAccount) and escalated privileges
actions.description: The actors enabled the built-in Windows account DefaultAccount and escalated privileges to gain administrator-level access.

actions.name: dumped and exfiltrated LSASS process memory for credential harvesting
actions.description: The IRGC-affiliated actors dumped and exfiltrated the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS) process memory to harvest credentials.

actions.name: made modifications to Task Scheduler
actions.description: The IRGC-affiliated actors may have made modifications to the Task Scheduler, potentially creating unrecognized scheduled tasks such as Wininet, WinLogon, and CacheTask.
